messages:
maria (sec-eng): Quick sync request — PM asked whether we should sample audit events before enrichment to reduce PII surface in downstream analytics. looking for a cross-team stance.
ajay (platform): +1 to discussing. sampling pre-enrichment changes what fields are persisted. do we mean: drop PII fields entirely, or redact then sample?
kelsey (privacy): Preference is redact before any persistent storage. sampling helps cost but can bias alerts. need to keep full fidelity for incidents.
maria (sec-eng): Right — tradeoffs: sampling reduces storage & exposure but hurts post-facto investigations. We should define classes: safety/security incidents -> no sampling; telemetry/operational -> sampleable.
tyler (sre): For operational spikes we already do tail-sampling for traces. Could adopt same idea: sample by route+error-rate. But need canonical event_id and correlation_id retained.
ajay (platform): Implementation idea: two-phase pipeline. ingest -> minimal canonical envelope (event_id, ts, actor_hash, route, severity) -> enrichment workers (may be async). Envelope stored encrypted with KMS. Enriched payload optional depending on sampling policy.
maria (sec-eng): envelope should avoid raw PII. 'actor_hash' not raw email/ID. store mapping only in secure vault for 30d if needed for incident. @kelsey does that satisfy privacy?
kelsey (privacy): Yes if mapping access is RBAC-gated and logged. Add requirement: enrichment may not reintroduce PII into the envelope bucket unless explicit justification + ticket.
ajay (platform): Config sketch for sampling policies (WIP):
```yaml
sampling_policies:
  - name: no_sample_security
    match: severity >= ERROR or tag in ["access_denied","data_exfil"]
    sample_rate: 1.0
  - name: route_operational
    match: route =~ "/api/v1/.*" and severity < ERROR
    sample_rate: 0.05
  - name: default
    sample_rate: 0.01
```
maria (sec-eng): Nice. also need schema hooks: schema must declare which fields are "sensitive" and forbidden in envelope. schema linter should fail CI if an event adds a sensitive field to envelope.
tyler (sre): +1 on linter. Also want a sampling-exempt flag for any event created by the incident response process so we always collect full event stream during triage.
ajay (platform): KMS note: envelope and full payload should be encrypted with customer or project-level keys where available. key rotation must be transparent to consumers. We'll need guidance from security on BYOK vs platform keys.
kelsey (privacy): BYOK for enterprise customers that require it. For Redwood-managed keys, retention and deletion policy must be crystal: when a customer requests deletion, we scrub envelopes and ensure backups follow.
maria (sec-eng): Action items: 1) Ajay: prototype two-phase pipeline + schema linter PR, 2) Kelsey: write privacy requirements for mapping store + access policy, 3) Tyler: propose RBAC roles for enrichment tooling, 4) All: review sampling policy draft. I'll open a short RFC.
ajay (platform): I'll include sample telemetry dashboards showing sampling bias so product can see impact.
kelsey (privacy): Happy to review RFC. think we should include explicit customer-facing wording: "what we log" + "what we sample" so SOC teams can respond to inquiries.
audit-bot: New RFC created: rfc/2026-04-audit-sampling-boundaries (link: https://redwood.internal/rfc/2026-04-audit-sampling-boundaries). Assigned owners: maria, ajay, kelsey, tyler.
maria (sec-eng): Thanks all. keeping this short — will collect feedback on RFC thread. :thumbsup:
